tasks.title: Analyze immutable client-scoped document overlays
tasks.goal: Run pure validation/navigation/configuration/boot preview over one disk-plus-buffer capture without saving it.
steps: Implement versioned open/change/close buffers with resource ID, underlying disk capture, encoding, content digest and created/deleted/moved intent scoped to client/context.
Freeze overlay sets into immutable analysis captures and feed the existing classified parsers/resolver/solver/pure builtin compiler.
Expose invalid/partial syntax diagnostics and raw resources; native/effectful analysis remains an explicit preparation operation, not a read.
positive_cases: One client's unsaved manifest alters its preview while another client sees saved state.
Ordinary Markdown/XML-data remain inert under overlay analysis.
negative_cases: An overlay silently updates lockfiles, installed profiles or disk.
A failed partial parse makes raw buffer content disappear.
checks: TO CREATE: two-client overlay, created/deleted/moved buffer and invalid-syntax fixtures.
acceptance: Queries for one analysis use exactly the same captured disk/overlay/world inputs.
No cross-client buffer leakage or implicit provider invocation occurs.
tasks.safe_stop: Overlay results are inspectable and disk remains byte-identical.
notes: Planned permanent destination: vibevm/vibespecs/common/PROP-067-machine-operations-and-observability.xml, reconciled with existing PROP-018/031/032/036/054; forward metadata only.

tasks.title: Convert positions and invalidate captured views honestly
tasks.goal: Provide accurate editor locations and resnapshot behavior across Unicode, generated resources and missed watches.
steps: Implement mechanical conversion between declared raw/projection offsets and negotiated editor encoding using exact document versions.
Tie child/page/chunk results and diagnostics to snapshot/filter IDs, preserving non-UTF8 bytes and unavailable mappings.
Translate disk/lock/policy/target/overlay changes into affected-ID invalidations; treat watchers as hints and missed windows as gap/expired requiring fresh capture.
positive_cases: Emoji, combining text and CRLF positions round-trip under negotiated encoding.
An unchanged captured view remains internally coherent while live disk changes.
negative_cases: Lost watcher events create a false current tree.
A watch notification automatically reruns install, native analysis or publication.
checks: TO CREATE: Unicode/source-map, stale-page and watch-gap conformance cases.
acceptance: Every diagnostic location identifies its exact source/projection revision and basis.
No total object/boot cap is introduced by paging.
tasks.safe_stop: Invalidated views remain historical captures; clients receive explicit resnapshot guidance.
tasks.commit_subject: feat(api): bind editor locations and invalidation to captures

tasks.title: Enforce saved-state edits with a cooperative barrier
tasks.goal: Separate buffer edit proposals from service-managed disk mutation and fence registered editors through commit.
steps: Implement buffer-only proposed edits with expected buffer versions; applying them changes no disk/domain state.

For service-managed apply require saved recaptured disk inputs and acquire an EditBarrier for all affected registered clients/resources/versions; require acknowledgement and hold it through CAS/commit.
Reject dirty/new-version/refused/expired/disconnected participants before further writes; preserve exact partial recovery after a landed write and disclose only authorized conflict metadata.
positive_cases: All registered clients acknowledge a clean barrier and exact saved-state edit commits.
A client can accept a buffer proposal, save explicitly and request a fresh domain plan.
negative_cases: A previously clean buffer changes after planning but disk hash still matches.
The editor and service both apply the same edit or another client's content leaks in conflict details.
checks: TO CREATE: barrier acknowledgement/version/lease/disconnect and post-write failure tests.
acceptance: Cleanliness guarantee is limited to registered participating buffers; disk CAS still guards other writers.
A dirty-buffer plan never becomes admitted solely because its content was later saved.
tasks.safe_stop: Barriers are released or recovery-owned; disk is unchanged or exact partial edits are journaled.
tasks.commit_subject: feat(api): fence saved-state edits with cooperative barriers
